overall_reason: The header marks 'Entry Showcase' as the current section and the phone footer lists every destination, but the header search is an unlabelled grey box and the two sidebar buttons do not share a corner radius.

score.reason: T-WHERE-AM-I and T-PHONE-NAV pass. T-FIELD-READ fails on the header search (CMP-006) and T-ONE-FAMILY on the sidebar buttons (CMP-005).

findings.where: ul.toolbar > li.search > form (#search_q), 1440px, tiles/1440-00.png top right
findings.evidence: The search field is a grey 197x40 box with only a magnifier icon. It has no visible label and no placeholder (fields row: placeholder null). The sweep's form_labels check reports 'input[type=search] has no label' (A11-010).
findings.before: An empty grey box with a magnifier stands for site search.
findings.after: Put a placeholder that names the scope, 'Search projects', in the box and give the field a label (visually hidden is enough next to the icon).
findings.why: Visitors cannot tell whether the box searches projects, people or the site before they type.
findings.title: Every field shows its label and what it needs

findings.where: div.page-sidebar: a.full.button 'VOTE' and a.left.flat-top 'VIEW ALL PROJECTS', 1440px, tiles/1440-00.png and tiles/1440-01.png
findings.evidence: The table's button variants give both dark filled buttons a 43 px height and weight 600, but 'VOTE' has a 3 px radius and 'VIEW ALL PROJECTS' a 0 px radius.
findings.before: The two sidebar buttons share fill and height but not corners.
findings.after: Use one radius for both sidebar buttons.
findings.why: Two near-identical buttons with different corners look like two kits.
findings.title: Controls belong to one family
